$comment: Single source of truth for cardiology measures shared by the HLS cardiology read API and the caldova-cardio-e2e agent platform. Keys match the platform scorer's MeasureSpec.key. Codes identify what is measured; units are UCUM. `source` names the system a displayed value comes from: fhir-observation and cardiac-device-telemetry values reach the app through FHIR -> bronze -> silver -> reporting gold; masimo-telemetry values come from the Masimo pulse-oximeter stream in the Eventhouse (TelemetryRaw, `telemetryField`), and the estate's masimo-fhir-aggregator records a 5-minute mean per device in FHIR (effectivePeriod, Observation.device), which then reaches reporting gold like any other Observation. maxAgeSeconds decides when a value is reported stale. SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY.

measures.label: Pulse rate
measures.notes: From the patient's associated Masimo Radius-7 (FHIR Basic device-assoc). Pulse-oximetry pulse rate, not ECG heart rate (LOINC 8867-4); the estate has no ECG monitor feed, so no heart-rate measure is catalogued.

measures.label: Oxygen saturation

code.display: Oxygen saturation in Arterial blood by Pulse oximetry

measures.notes: From the patient's associated Masimo Radius-7. Pulse-oximetry SpO2 (59408-5), not arterial blood-gas saturation (2708-6).

measures.label: Device flow index
measures.notes: No standard code exists for this demonstration measure. Produced only by the synthetic cardiac-device feed.
